evidence.quote: The microbial community compositions in the collected stool and swab samples were analyzed by 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing.
Negative controls used during DNA extraction and 16S rRNA gene amplification were included in the sample processing workflow
used for decontamination of sequencing results before downstream analysis as previously described.

notes: No reliable target-site microbial signature after removal. Named genera in results concern neonatal/maternal mucosal samples, excluded. No supplements available.
